Trace, implement and test: 04.01.Route Between Nodes

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    bool findWhetherExistsPath(int n, vector<vector<int>>& graph, int start, int target) {
        vector<int> g[n];
        vector<bool> vis(n);
        for (auto& e : graph) {
            g[e[0]].push_back(e[1]);
        }
        auto dfs = [&](this auto&& dfs, int i) -> bool {
            if (i == target) {
                return true;
            }
            if (vis[i]) {
                return false;
            }
            vis[i] = true;
            for (int j : g[i]) {
                if (dfs(j)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        };
        return dfs(start);
    }
};
